patch.value: From pm-cli PR #108 review of managed pm-changelog@2026.6.4. With normal npx pm-changelog --body-preview and pm changelog generate --body-preview extension usage, items are loaded through pm list-all --json / listAllFrontMatter, which usually do not include document body content. As a result item.body is absent and previews silently do not render for real pm items. Expected: load item bodies when bodyPreview is set, or explicitly document that body-preview only works with custom stdin JSON containing body.
